| Deploy on table. Once during opponent's move phase, you may use 3 Force to look at opponent's hand or place a Political Effect (and all cards on it) in owner's Used Pile. Once during opponent's move phase, you may use 3 Force to look at opponent's hand or place a Political Effect (and all cards on it) in owner's Used Pile. Opponent may not place cards in your Used Pile {{Errata hl|1=from your hand}} while you have fewer than 13 cards in hand. (Immune to Alter) || Deploy on table. During opponent’s move phase, may use 3 Force to peek at opponent’s hand or place a Political Effect (and all cards on it) in owner’s Used Pile.
